parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user

parameters.help_en:

zh: Chinese.

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded image of the real-name verification material. The image must meet the following requirements:
The image is in JPG or BMP format.
The size of the original image is 55 KB to 1 MB
parameters.help_zh:
使用Base64编码的实名认证资料图片。图片要求如下：
图片为jpg或bmp格式；

parameters.name: identity_credential

parameters.help_en: The certificate number of the real-name verification material, such as the ID card number or Unified Social Credit Code
parameters.help_zh: 实名认证资料证件号码，如：身份证号码、统一社会信用代码
parameters.name: identity_credential_no

parameters.help_en:
The type of the certificate used for real-name verification. Valid values:
SFZ: ID card.
HZ: Passport.
YYZZ: Business license.
ORG: Organization code certificate.
XYDM: Unified Social Credit Code certificate.
TXZ: Mainland Travel Permit for Hong Kong and Macao Residents.

If the certificate you use is not listed above, refer to the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72209.html section to view the value of the corresponding certificate type.
Make sure that the selected certificate type matches the certificate you provide
parameters.help_zh:
实名认证证件类型。取值：
SFZ：身份证；
HZ：护照；
YYZZ：营业执照；
ORG：组织机构代码证；
XYDM：统一社会信用代码证书；
TXZ：港澳居民来往内地通行证。

如果您使用的证件不在上述范围中，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72209.html章节，查看相应证件类型的取值。
请务必选择与您传入的证件一致的证件类型
parameters.name: identity_credential_type
